sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition under Sections 437 and 439 of Cr.P.C., has been filed by the petitioner/accused seeking regular bail in Cr.No.57/2024 of Gajuwaka Police Station,
Visakhapatnam.
2. The above said crime was registered against the petitioner/accused for the offence punishable under Section 376(3), 363, 506 IPC and Section 3(a) read with 4 of POCSO Act, 2012.
3. The case of the prosecution is as follows:
On 26.01.2024, mother of the victim girl gave report stating that her daughter/victim girl was aged about 14 years and studying 8th standard in K.V.School, Malkapuram.
On 25.01.2024, she did not return home from school and that the complainant's mother called her and informed her that the victim girl came to her house.
Immediately in the morning of 26.01.2024, the complainant went to her mother's house and enquired about the girl.

Upon which, the girl stated that about five months back she got acquaintance with the accused who used to follow her in the name of love and lured her with his deceitful words and on 25.01.2024 in the evening at 4.30pm, he took the girl to Gafoor's room and tried to have sexual intercourse with her.

But in the meanwhile, people in the vicinity who observed the visit of the victim girl and the accused to the room, locked the room from out side and created galata,
upon which the girl left the room and one Laxmanarao had dropped her at Jaggu junction.
Again she went to the said room by walk.
She also stated that about two months back the accused took her on his bike to his room, touched her body improperly and forcibly inserted his penis into her month.
The complainant also stated that she came to know that the accused is having criminal background.
Basing on the report, the accused was arrested and remanded to judicial custody on 27.01.2024.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the petitioner has been in judicial custody from 27.01.2024.
Even after expiry of 60 days period, charge sheet is not filed, as such petitioner is entitled for statutory bail.
5. On the other hand, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor confirms non- filing of charge sheet by the police and opposed for grant of bail to the petitioner.
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor further submitted that the petitioner is a habitual offender and a rowdy sheet is also opened against the petitioner.
He further submitted that the investigation is at crucial stage.

sentences.text: 6. Heard both sides.

7. Now, the point for consideration is:
Whether the petitioner/accused can be released on grant of bail?

POINT:
8. Perused the entire material on record.

9. Considering the serious nature of the allegations made against the petitioner against a minor girl who is aged about 14 years and also considering the submission that investigation is at crucial stage,
this Court views that the release of the accused would cause hampering of investigation and tampering of evidence and keeping note of the antecedents of the petitioner, at this stage, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
10. In the result, the criminal petition is dismissed.
